meta.name: migrate-slack-agents
meta.description: Migrate a classic single-bot Slack install to one provisioned Slack app per existing agent group while preserving agent identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring behavior — or record the operator's choice to stay on classic, which remains supported. Use when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone any time later.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 Slack 机器人架构为每组独立应用，保留身份与记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在使用经典 Slack 机器人并需按 agent 分组独立应用
copy.tagline_en: Migrate classic Slack bots to per-agent apps, preserving identities and memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a classic Slack bot setup and need per-agent Slack apps

howto.what: 把每个经由经典 Slack 适配器接线的 agent 组，迁移为一个独立的命名 Slack 应用（slack-<slug>），保留原有身份、工作区、记忆和接线行为；也可选择继续使用经典模式。整个过程不创建 agent 组，也不修改 agent 工作区。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 提出 Slack agents 要求时，或之后任何时间单独运行本技能时触发。

say.text: 我选择继续使用经典 Slack，不迁移。
say.note: 记录选择，经典模式继续照常工作。

say.text: 检查 Slack 迁移进度，确认是否已完成。
say.note: 返回是否已迁移完成或仍需执行。

howto.what_en: Migrates each agent group currently wired through the classic Slack adapter into its own named Slack app (slack-<slug>), preserving identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring behavior; or records the operator's choice to stay on classic. Never creates an agent group or edits agent workspaces.
howto.when_en: Triggered when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or any time later when run standalone.

say_en.text: Migrate each classic Slack agent group to its own slack-<slug> app.
say_en.note: Starts the guided migration flow after checking classic state.

say_en.text: I choose to stay on classic Slack; don't migrate.
say_en.note: Records the choice and keeps classic mode working.

say_en.text: Check Slack migration status and confirm if complete.
say_en.note: Reports whether migration is done or still needed.
